CodexBar asks the official Claude Code CLI to render `/usage` on your computer, then receives only sanitized percentages, reset times, plan, and freshness over your local network.

1. Install Claude Code and complete `claude` sign-in once. 2. Download and start the Claude companion from this project’s Release on the same Wi-Fi. 3. Tap the secure scanner below—do not use the system camera—or paste the pairing code, then keep the companion running.
Starts with CBCLAUDE1. Treat it like a local-device password.
No Anthropic access token, refresh token, setup-token, prompt, response, file, email address, or CLI session text is transferred to Android. Only the encrypted quota snapshot leaves your computer.
Keep Google sign-in inside the official Gemini CLI on your computer. CodexBar receives only model labels, used percentages, reset times, tier, and freshness over your local network.

1. Download and start the Gemini companion from this project’s Release on the same Wi-Fi. 2. Scan its QR code with your phone, or paste the pairing code below. 3. Keep the companion running while Gemini monitoring is needed.
Starts with codexbar://gemini-pair. Treat it like a local-device password.
No Google access token, refresh token, OAuth client ID, prompt, file, email address, or CLI session content is transferred to Android. The pairing key is encrypted with Android Keystore.
Optionally add current context size plus daily and model token totals from Codex CLI sessions on your computer. Your OpenAI quota connection remains separate.
1. Download and start the Codex telemetry companion from this project’s Release on the same Wi-Fi. 2. Scan its QR code or paste the pairing code below. 3. Keep it running for fresh local insights.

Only aggregate token counts, model labels, dates, and current context size are encrypted and transferred. Prompts, responses, file paths, session IDs, source files, and credentials stay on your computer.

Cursor does not provide a supported mobile device-code flow. In a desktop browser signed in to cursor.com, copy the Cookie request header from /api/usage-summary and paste it below. Treat it like a password. CodexBar validates it only against cursor.com, never follows redirects, and encrypts it after validation.

Create or copy an API token from the z.ai Coding Plan dashboard. This release connects only to the fixed Global endpoint at api.z.ai; BigModel China and team selectors remain disabled until their region fields can be stored and validated separately.
Create a Management API key at zenmux.ai/platform/management. Standard inference API keys do not work. CodexBar requests only subscription quota details and never reads prompts or request logs.

Create an API key in the Kimi Code console and paste it below. CodexBar sends it only to api.kimi.com/coding/v1/usages to read the rolling and weekly coding quotas; it never requests prompts or inference history.

Create a restricted API key in ElevenLabs and allow User subscription read access. CodexBar reads character and voice-slot quotas from api.elevenlabs.io; it never requests generated audio, voices, or project content.

Create a dedicated OpenRouter API key and set a daily, weekly, or monthly credit limit for the most useful progress bar. CodexBar reads only the current key’s limit and usage from openrouter.ai/api/v1/key. A management key is not required.

Create a dedicated Synthetic API key and paste it below. CodexBar calls the quota-only endpoint at api.synthetic.new/v2/quotas; Synthetic documents that this request does not count against subscription limits.

Create a dedicated scoped Chutes API key in the dashboard and paste it below. CodexBar reads only the authenticated user’s 4-hour and monthly subscription caps from api.chutes.ai. Use the minimum read scope that permits subscription usage.

Create a dedicated DeepSeek API key and paste it below. CodexBar sends it only to api.deepseek.com/user/balance to read API availability and USD/CNY balances; it never requests prompts, chat history, or model responses.

Create a dedicated Venice API key with the narrowest permission that can read billing balance. CodexBar sends it only to api.venice.ai/api/v1/billing/balance to read API availability, DIEM epoch allocation, and USD/DIEM balances; it never requests prompts or inference history.

Paste an API key created on the international Moonshot API platform. This is different from a Kimi Code subscription key. CodexBar sends it only to api.moonshot.ai/v1/users/me/balance to read available, cash, and voucher balances; it never requests prompts or model responses.

Create a dedicated API key in Cline and paste it below. CodexBar sends it only to api.cline.bot/api/v1/users/me/plan/usage-limits to read 5-hour, weekly, and monthly plan usage. Prompts, model responses, and request history are never requested.

Create an API key in the IBM Bob portal and paste it below. CodexBar reads monthly Bobcoin budgets for each visible team. Credentials are sent only to HTTPS API hosts strictly under bob.ibm.com; prompts and coding history are never requested.

Create a dedicated API key in Fireworks AI and enter the account slug from your account URL. CodexBar sends both only to api.fireworks.ai to total rated spend from the last 30 days. It never requests prompts or model responses.
For example, the value after /accounts/ in your Fireworks account URL.

Create an API key for OpenCode Go and paste it below. CodexBar calls only https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage to read the rolling 5-hour, weekly, and monthly Go plan usage windows. The key is sent only as a bearer credential to the fixed opencode.ai host, redirects and HTTP logging are disabled, and it is encrypted with Android Keystore after validation.

Show model usage and reset times from Antigravity on your Windows PC. This is separate from Gemini CLI and your Claude subscription.

1. Keep the signed-in Antigravity IDE open on your PC. 2. Start the Antigravity companion. 3. Scan its QR here. Across different networks, connect both devices to Tailscale and use the PC’s 100.x address.
Starts with CBANTIGRAVITY1. Keep it private like a password.
Google credentials, conversations, files and email stay on the PC. Only encrypted model quotas and reset times are sent. Unknown quotas and weekly limits are not estimated.
